writing.exampleCaption: A separate crate, marked as a proc-macro, built for the host.
writing.explanation: It receives a TokenStream and returns one, running as a real program during compilation — which is why it lives in its own crate compiled for the host machine. That host requirement is exactly why a device-local compiler cannot execute one, and why #[derive(Serialize)] needs a desktop toolchain.
